entries.title: II Samuel 20:1
segments: ¶And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjaminite; and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, Israel.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:2
segments: Then all the men of Israel went up from after David, following Sheba the son of Bichri. But the men of Judah clave to their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:3
segments: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women, concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in a house of confinement and maintained them, but did not go in to them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:4
segments: ¶And the king said to Amasa, Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and do thou attend here.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:5
segments: So Amasa went to call together [the men of] Judah; but he delayed longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:6
segments: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom. Take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fortified cities and escape our sight.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:7
segments: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:8
segments: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came before them. And Joab was girded with his coat, his dress, and upon it was the girdle of the sword which was fastened on his loins in its sheath; and as he went forth it fell out.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:9
segments: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou well, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:10
segments: And Amasa had taken no notice of the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him with it in the belly and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. And Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:11
segments: And one of Joab's young men stood by [Amasa] and said, He that favours Joab, and he that is for David, let him follow Joab.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:12
segments: Now Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by stood still.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:13
segments: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri,

entries.title: II Samuel 20:14
segments: ¶who went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, and to Beth-Maacah, and all the Berim; and they gathered together, and went also after him.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:15
segments: And they came and besieged him in Abel-Beth-Maacah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it was raised in the trench; and all the people that were with Joab sapped the wall, to throw it down.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:16
segments: And a wise woman cried out of the city, Hear, hear: say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:17
segments: And he came near to her; and the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he said, I [am he]. And she said to him, Listen to the words of thy handmaid. And he said, I am listening.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:18
segments: And she spoke saying, They were wont to speak in old time saying, Just inquire in Abel; and so they ended.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:19
segments: I am peaceable [and] faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of Jehovah?

entries.title: II Samuel 20:20
segments: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:21
segments: The matter is not so; but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David: give up him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said to Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:22
segments: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

entries.title: II Samuel 20:23
segments: ¶And Joab was over all the host of Israel; and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites;

entries.title: II Samuel 20:24
segments: and Adoram was over the levy; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

entries.title: II Samuel 20:25
segments: and Sheva was scribe; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

entries.title: II Samuel 20:26
segments: and Ira also, the Jairite, was David's chief ruler.
